name: Flow
tagline: Translate anything from your menu bar: on-device by default, DeepL or any LLM when you want it.
description: Flow is a small translator that lives in your menu bar. Type or paste text and the translation appears as you type, on your Mac with Apple's built-in engine. When you want more polish, switch to DeepL or any OpenAI-compatible model, local Ollama included. 115 languages, interface in 20.
